summary: DERIBIT_OPTIONS_SOURCE_DESIGN_READY_DEFER_ACTIVATION. The predecessor WAIT_FOR_NAMED_POINT_IN_TIME_PROOF is reconciled by frozen official-document facts: one prospective get_instruments request fixed to BTC/option/expired=false defines the active option universe, and one contemporaneous BTC/option book-summary request exposes the named availability fields. A disabled contract can seal each raw response with actual received_at and SHA-256, retain documented identity fields, and require unique exact instrument_name set equality; any missing, extra, duplicate, identity disagreement, gap, drift or schema change fails the observation closed without backfill. expiration_timestamp and numeric strike are authoritative; symbol form and 08:00 UTC expiry are consistency checks. This is PERSONAL_RESEARCH_ONLY design readiness, not source, factor or operational readiness. The charter permits only the isolated OKX external source, and the frozen snapshot shows R2 at 0/14. Endpoint access, live continuity, non-personal rights, storage or redistribution compatibility, capture, deployment and activation remain denied or MISSING_PROOF. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effects are zero; every predictive and economic claim remains MISSING_PROOF.

checks.evidence: Design fixes one get_instruments request to currency=BTC, kind=option and expired=false, sealing raw bytes, actual received_at and SHA-256 and retaining instrument_name, is_active, creation_timestamp, expiration_timestamp and numeric strike for every row.

checks.name: SUMMARY_REQUEST
checks.evidence: Design fixes one immediately following get_book_summary_by_currency request to currency=BTC and kind=option in the same observation attempt, separately sealing raw bytes, actual received_at and SHA-256 and retaining instrument_name, creation_timestamp, bid_price, ask_price, open_interest, underlying_price and mark_iv availability.

checks.name: EXACT_UNIVERSE_COMPLETENESS
checks.evidence: Completeness is exact set equality between unique active BTC option instrument_name values and unique summary instrument_name values. Duplicate, missing or extra names, a partial surface or alternate-product aggregation closes the observation.

checks.name: SEMANTIC_IDENTITY
checks.evidence: expiration_timestamp and numeric strike are authoritative. BTC-DDMMMYY-STRIKE-C_OR_P and 08:00 UTC expiry are independent consistency checks; disagreement closes the observation rather than selecting a parser guess.

checks.name: CONTINUITY_AND_DRIFT
checks.evidence: Availability, accuracy and unchanged functionality are unguaranteed, and no response was accessed. A future gap, schema drift, set mismatch or identity disagreement must close that observation and cannot be backfilled, repaired from history or retried into accepted evidence.

checks.name: PERSONAL_USE_RIGHTS_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: Public unauthenticated access is documented, but Terms limit Market Data and Derived Data to personal use absent explicit approval. Repository or server storage, redistribution, commercial use and organizational capture compatibility are not authorized or proven.

checks.name: CHARTER_ACTIVATION_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: The charter permits external capture only through the isolated fixed OKX source. This audit freezes only a disabled design and authorizes no endpoint call, source contract, capture, registration, deployment, timer, writer, charter change or server action.

checks.name: READINESS_DISPOSITION
checks.evidence: DERIBIT_OPTIONS_SOURCE_DESIGN_READY_DEFER_ACTIVATION is selected because documented fields and exact two-request equality suffice for one deterministic disabled contract. No official fact contradicts it and no additional technical fact is needed to describe it; live, rights and activation proof remain denied.

checks.name: FACTOR_AND_STRATEGY_BOUNDARY
checks.evidence: No factor, expiry bucket, delta proxy, strike band, formula, transform, sign, threshold, horizon, strategy mapping, hypothesis, candidate, manifest, experiment, trigger or OOS action was selected or created.

checks.name: PERFORMANCE_AND_DRAWDOWN
checks.evidence: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effects are exactly zero. No observations or outcomes were accessed. Predictive value, matched-capital economics, fees, slippage, capacity, utilization, turnover, holding age, stability and drawdown benefit remain MISSING_PROOF.

checks.name: OPPORTUNITY_COST
checks.evidence: This audit closes the documentation-only technical gap without spending server capacity or repeating the four-family audit. Deferral preserves the active R2 evidence lane and avoids speculative implementation under unresolved rights and charter boundaries.

checks.name: ZERO_CHANGE_SAFETY
checks.evidence: No network, browser, endpoint, server, Research MCP, canonical state, .research-state, OOS or Trading access occurred. Final HEAD and origin stayed exact and the worktree remained clean with zero changed files and artifacts.

checks.name: RESULT_SCHEMA_VALIDATION
checks.evidence: The in-memory object passed the repository dependency-neutral result validator against the exact task and task SHA-256; no result file was created.

uncertainty: MISSING_PROOF: live response availability, paired-snapshot continuity, operational latency, rate-limit behavior and schema stability.
MISSING_PROOF: explicit approval for non-personal use, repository or server storage, redistribution, Derived Data use and organizational operation.
MISSING_PROOF: charter exception, source registration, capture transport, deployment, activation and live continuity evidence.
MISSING_PROOF: R2 terminal evidence; the frozen snapshot reports R2 WAITING_FOR_DAY at 0/14 and was not refreshed.
MISSING_PROOF: factor semantics, predictive value, fees, slippage, capacity, stability, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness and OOS.
recommended_next_action: Preserve this design as disabled and take no implementation or source-access action. Continue the active R2 evidence lane. Only after R2 reaches an observable terminal disposition, explicit Deribit approval covers the intended non-personal storage and use boundary, and separate charter and source authorization exists may Manager freeze one new bounded prospective source-contract task.
